_comment: Phase 6 — Multi-Company meta. No more tenant_id. The fixed holding_company_id (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001) is the seed Holding that the DefaultHoldingBootstrapHostedService inserts on first startup. Subsidiaries created by register/admin use distinct random UUIDs but share the same parent_company_id = holding_company_id.
